skill_feedback: Guard resolves only inline literal SQL: parenthesized multi-line SQL constants are opaque to the resolver — inlined single-line literals or static .sql via `psql -f` only.

`export *DSN*="...$(databricks ...)"` is blocked as a SQL-client command substitution; guard-clean form is a passwordless DSN env + `PGPASSWORD=$(databricks postgres generate-database-credential ...)` on the same exec line (credential minted per call).

Mapping spec asymmetry: spec declares root_where on filtered objects with no target_where and the engine requires symmetric scoping; worker-side fix is a scoped copy under .migration/recon/<unit>/ with target_where set to the identical predicate (committed spec untouched).
Oracle DATE must land as `timestamp(0)` on Lakebase per canonicalization type_map; `date` is only allowed with census_midnight_only evidence and breaks datetime identity canonicalization.

ALL_TRIGGERS/ALL_OBJECTS expose zero OW_BILLING triggers to the RO principal — deploying assigned target triggers yields trigger_extra tier-0 findings classed `structural` (merge-ineligible, not worker-fixable).

Dedicated routine-parity exec target can be a schema `<branch>_exec` on the allowlisted branch; run records need target_branch `mig-1793185083-exec`, snapshot `fixture:<repo-path>`, and must be committed before grading.
rerun-proof `--fresh` requires a wrapped run record {run,status,evidence,shape}, not raw `shape` output; `shape --out` is a file path and must run from the repo root for the allowlist check.
Redeploying functions with changed signatures fails on `cannot change return type`; routines DDL needs leading `DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS` for idempotency.
factory-doctor rewrites .migration/capabilities.json on every run — restore via `git checkout` before committing so it doesn't appear in the PR.
